text:
Rina Gomez: quick sync: launching the newsletter + 2-email nurture for the new benchmark post. main asks: geo send windows, subject personalization, replay routing for non-registrants.
Miles Carter: propose US/CA Wed 10am PT, EMEA Thu 11am CET, APAC Mon 10am SGT. timezone-specific CTAs.
Bea Ortiz: deliverability ops: run seed & ISP checks 24h prior, suppress ActiveCustomers and partner_trials. also set 5% canary for first 10 minutes.
Tomás Alvarez: segmentation: tag inbound leads with source=benchmark_post. high_intent = visited:/benchmarks/docs OR clicked=bench_cta -> immediate register invite; others into 48hr nurture. I'll export CSV Wed 6am PT.
Rina Gomez: creative ask: two hero variants (chart vs human), short hero line (25 chars), 90-char preheader, and CTA text (Register / Read the post). Bea, can you own the seeds?
Bea Ortiz: yep. seeds scheduled 2025-04-07T09:00Z. will post results.
Miles Carter: subject tests: (A) "Benchmark released + live demo" (B) "How we reduced token costs by 3x". target B to dev/infra segment.
Tomás Alvarez: webhook payload example for sales tagging: `{ lead_id: "{{id}}", tags: ["bench_inbound"], source: "benchmark_post" }`
engage-bot: Calendar event created: "Benchmark launch newsletter" 2025-04-09T17:00:00Z. Invites sent to #marketing #growth.
Rina Gomez: analytics: track opens->registers->replays. Miles will spin up dashboard for register velocity and playback views.
Miles Carter: noted. I'll include subject variant breakdown and region split. link when ready.
Bea Ortiz: ops: configure ESP to localize date/time strings, set retries for webhook failures (3 attempts), throttle EU sends if bounce rate spikes.
Tomás Alvarez: export columns: email, first_name, region, source, last_activity, tags. will drop CSV to shared drive and ping ops.
Rina Gomez: timeline recap: copy + assets Tue EOD, segments exported Wed 6am PT, US send Wed 10am PT, EMEA Thu 11am CET, APAC Mon 10am SGT. owners: Miles (copy+analytics), Bea (ops+deliverability), Tomás (segmentation), Rina (launch lead).
Miles Carter: I'll post hero line + preheader later today.
Rina Gomez: perfect. keep thread tight during QA window. :rocket:
